run_train_main: run the main training loop that initializes config, pre-trains models, and trains with validation
validate_batch_validate: validate a batch of samples by computing loss and accuracy across the validation data loader
pre_train_models: pre-train individual models for a specified number of epochs with learning rate decay and checkpointing
train_models: train all models end-to-end with loss computation, backpropagation, validation, and rendering outputs
plot_training_stats: plot training statistics including loss, train loss, and accuracy over epochs using CSV data
